# `repo.delete`

Soft-delete a repository

Role admin. Soft-deletes with a purge horizon, emits repo.deleted, and enqueues the repo_purge job. Requires a current If-Match entity tag.

- Method and path: `POST /{owner}/{repo}/settings/delete`
- Scope: `admin:write`
- Kind: `mutation`
- CLI: `rukie repo delete`
- MCP: `repo_delete`
- Idempotency-Key: required on this mutation
- ETag: served; send it back as If-Match to write safely

## Inputs

| Name | In | Required | Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$schema` | body | no | `string` |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | no | `string` |
| `If-Match` | header | no | `string` |
| `confirm` | body | yes | `string` |
| `owner` | path | yes | `string` |
| `repo` | path | yes | `string` |

`forbidden`, `invalid`, `not-found`, `precondition-required`, `stale`, `unauthorized`, `validation`, plus the framework problems.
